integrity: A symbolic proof proves the result for all prime powers and dimensions at least two. Finite exhaustive examples independently check special cases but do not replace the proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: Counts only maximal nilpotency-index products of independent uniform upper triangular factors; not all Jordan types, not factors conditioned individually nilpotent, not arbitrary rings. Absolute historical priority is unestablished.
title: Maximal nilpotency index in products of random upper triangular matrices
